shortDescription: Manage AC pods in Everpure FlashArrays

options.name: api_token
options.description: FlashArray API token for admin privileged user.

options.name: client_id
options.description: ID of the API Client that issues the identity token. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: context
options.description: Name of fleet member on which to perform the operation. This requires the array receiving the request is a member of a fleet and the context name to be a member of the same fleet.

options.name: default_protection_pg
options.description: Name of the default protection default for the pod Only applicable for existing pods Name must include the pod name Will create the PG in the pod if it doesn't already exist To remove an existing default protection group provide I([])

options.name: delete_contents
options.description: This enables you to eradicate pods with contents.

options.name: disable_warnings
options.description: Disable insecure certificate warnings in debug logs

options.name: eradicate
options.description: Define whether to eradicate the pod on delete or leave in trash.

options.name: fa_url
options.description: FlashArray management IPv4 address or Hostname.

options.name: failover
options.description: The name of the array given priority to stay online if arrays loose contact with each other. Options are either array in the cluster, or I(auto)

options.name: id_token
options.description: A pre-signed JWT to authenticate with, as an alternative to I(api_token). The token is exchanged by the array for a short-lived access token. Requires a matching API Client to be registered on the array (see M(everpure.flasharray.purefa_apiclient)).

options.name: ignore_usage
options.description: Flag used to override checks for quota management operations. If set to true, pod usage is not checked against the quota_limits that are set. If set to false, the actual logical bytes in use are prevented from exceeding the limits set on the pod. Client operations might be impacted. If the limit exceeds the quota, the operation is not allowed.

options.name: issuer
options.description: The API Client's trusted identity issuer registered on the array. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: key_id
options.description: Key ID of the API Client that issues the identity token. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: mediator
options.description: Name of the mediator to use for a pod

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the pod. To place a pod inside a realm either set the I(realm) parameter, or provide the fully-qualified C(realm::pod) name here (for example C(myrealm::mypod)). If I(realm) is set, do not also use the C(::) form in this parameter.

options.name: private_key_file
options.description: Path to the PEM RSA private key used to sign an identity token, as an alternative to I(api_token). Requires I(client_id), I(key_id), I(issuer) and I(username).

options.name: private_key_password
options.description: Password protecting I(private_key_file), if encrypted.

options.name: promote
options.description: Promote/demote any pod not in a stretched relationship. . Demoting a pod will render it read-only.

options.name: quiesce
options.description: Quiesce/Skip quiesce when I(promote) is false and demoting an ActiveDR pod. Quiesce will ensure all local data has been replicated before demotion. Skipping quiesce looses all pending data to be replicated to the remote pod. Can only demote the pod if it is in a Acrive DR replica link relationship. This will default to True

options.name: quota
options.description: Logical quota limit of the pod in K, M, G, T or P units, or bytes.

options.name: realm
options.description: Name of the realm the pod belongs to. When set, the pod is created (or managed) as C(realm::pod). This is a convenience for the C(realm::pod) naming convention and is mutually exclusive with providing C(::) directly in I(name). Requires Purity//FA 6.6.11, or higher (REST 2.36).

options.name: retention_lock
options.description: Define if I(default_protection_pg) has retention lock enabled

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the pod should exist or not.

options.name: stretch
options.description: The name of the array to stretch to/unstretch from. Must be synchromously replicated. To unstretch an array use state I(absent) You can only specify a remote array, ie you cannot unstretch a pod from the current array and then restretch back to the current array. To restretch a pod you must perform this from the remaining array the pod resides on.

options.name: target
options.description: Name of clone target pod.

options.name: throttle
options.description: Allows pod creation to fail if array health is not optimal

options.name: undo
options.description: Use the I(undo-remote) pod when I(promote) is true and promoting an ActiveDR pod. This will default to True

options.name: username
options.description: Username the issued token should be granted to. Must be a valid user on the array. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: with_default_protection
options.description: Whether to keep the default container protection for the pod Only applicable for first creation of a pod
